entities.summary: Troy Stetina is an American guitarist and music educator. He was the director of Rock Guitar Studies at the Wisconsin Conservatory of Music and writer for Guitar One magazine, and now teaches independently. He has more than forty rock and metal instructional methods and has sold over 1 million units. He has authored over 40 guitar methods for Hal Leonard LLC.
